scope: Release Tauri startup probe using the existing production frontend and a private copy of the personal SQLite library; does not measure Dock/LaunchServices overhead or prolonged-idle conditions.
limitations: Probe adds DOM observation and two animation-frame callbacks.
Probe uses the default Tauri window configuration, rather than the installed bundle macOS overlay.
The first launch was after building a new executable; this does not reproduce the exact idle interval reported by the user.
